dashboard.title: Your room for growth
dashboard.subtitle: Clear your mind — keep tasks, goals, and thoughts in one place
descriptionSentences: MindHaven is a space to move everything that's usually spinning in your head.
You no longer need to keep tasks, goals, and worries in memory — they're always at hand.
Here it's easier to see the big picture and understand where you're heading.
As you build goals, you gradually uncover new details that help you move forward.
The journal helps you reflect, capture thoughts, and observe yourself from the outside.
The AI assistant offers guidance, helps refine your plan, and reveals possible sources of anxiety.
At every step — in goals, tasks, or entries — you get support and clarity.
Free your mind from the noise and focus on what truly matters.

ascent.coreRule: The core rule — “{behavior}” — stays strict for the whole challenge. It cannot be bought off with XP.
ascent.unlockHint: 0 means the restriction never lifts on its own. Any other number is how many successful days must pass before it stops.
ascent.restrictionsEmptyBody: For example: no coffee until 3 successful days, or no café until 5.

ascent.debtsHint: Extra actions you confirm by hand. If one is still open at the end of the day, the day is not successful.
ascent.debtsEmptyBody: Add one only when the day needs a required step beyond habits and restrictions.
ascent.earnHint: These actions are optional. They grant XP and are not part of the day’s debt by themselves.
ascent.earnEmptyBody: For example: 100 push-ups for 40 XP, or a 3 km run for 70 XP.
ascent.rulesText: If at least one required condition is not met by the end of the day, the current streak and the available XP balance reset to zero. The personal record and history are kept.
